text: We booked Japan!!! Flights in April. I've already made a spreadsheet of ramen shops.
Starting the new job on Monday. Can't stop thinking about all the things I'll get to build.
Concert tomorrow! Front row! Bea and I have matching shirts ready.
The publisher wants to see the full manuscript. Not a yes yet but it's the closest I've ever been.
Puppy comes home Saturday. Bought a bed, a lead, eleven toys. I have a problem.
Two days until I see Malik after eight months apart. I'm counting hours.
First seeds of the year went in today. Already imagining the summer salad.
The band said yes, I can join as their drummer! First rehearsal Thursday.
Can't sleep, too buzzed about the hackathon. We have the idea. We have the team. Let's go.
We find out the baby's sex next week. Leaning towards not finding out but I'm so curious.
Mohammed got us tickets to the cup final!! I'm going to lose my voice.
Moving into the new flat in nine days. Already measuring for shelves.
Got invited to speak at the conference in Berlin. Me! Up on a stage!
Christmas Eve buzz. Lights on, cookies in the oven, Leo can't sit still and honestly neither can I.
Bought my first camera. Going out at sunrise tomorrow to shoot the harbour.
Bit excited about the date tonight with Celeste. Trying to play it cool. Not playing it cool.
The grant is shortlisted! Final decision in a month. Trying not to plan the whole project in my head already. Failing.
Snow forecast overnight and I'm like a kid checking the window every ten minutes.
Last day of exams tomorrow and then SUMMER. Freedom.
Our startup demo day is next week and three investors have RSVP'd. Practising the pitch in the shower.
Signed up for the half marathon. Terrified, thrilled, already googling running shoes.
Nadine's coming to stay for the whole week! Cleaned the spare room, bought her favourite tea.
Course starts in October and I've already read half the reading list. Nerd and proud.
They want me to lead the redesign. My own team, my own vision. Can't wait to start.
Road trip planned for the long weekend. Playlist: done. Snacks: overdone. Car: borrowed from Gil.
The festival line-up dropped and every band I love is playing. Bought tickets in four minutes.
Wedding in three weeks. Dress fitting today. Seeing it all come together gave me chills.
Tomorrow I start learning to dive. Open water by the end of the week if the instructor, Mika, thinks I'm ready.
Gig at the pub on Friday. Our first ever with people who aren't related to us.
Grandkids arrive tomorrow! Baked three cakes. Don't tell their mother.
New project at work is exactly what I've wanted to do for years. Woke up early just wanting to get started.
Telescope arrived! Clear skies tonight. Saturn, here I come.
Yesterday felt flat but today I've got that fizzy feeling about the trip again.
Orientation week! So many clubs. Signed up for climbing, debate and something called 'competitive cheese tasting'.
Mira said she might be pregnant. Test tomorrow morning. We're trying not to get our hopes up and absolutely getting our hopes up.
The kitchen renovation starts Monday. Goodbye 1970s brown tiles!
Mild buzz about the weekend. Nothing big planned, just looking forward to it.
Getting my first tattoo on Saturday. Designed it myself. Zahra's coming to hold my hand.
Countdown to the eclipse: four days. We're driving to the path of totality and I have the special glasses.
Seo-yeon just told me she's moving to my city! Pinch me.
First home game of the season tonight. Scarf on since breakfast.
Applying for the master's programme and actually excited for the first time in ages about what's next.
Restaurant opens in two weeks. Menus printed, chairs arrived, Rocco keeps re-tasting the sauce.
Can't wait for Diwali at Nani's. Lamps, sweets, all the cousins in one house.
Got a callback for the second audition!!! Callbacks are Wednesday.
Bought the paints, cleared the table, the course starts tonight. I've wanted to try oils since I was a teenager.
So hyped for the game launch tonight. Took tomorrow off. Snacks stockpiled.
Interview at my dream company next week. Practising answers and getting more excited than nervous, which is new.
Harvest festival planning with the whole street. Jean-Luc's doing a cider press. I'm on bunting.
We close on the house on Friday! Our own front door!
Little thrill reading the itinerary for the work trip. Lisbon for three days. I haven't travelled in years.
Our robotics team made the national finals. Practising until the caretaker kicks us out.
Tomorrow is the first day of my sabbatical. A whole year to write. I keep grinning at nothing.
Tickets for the musical go on sale at 10. Alarm set. Three devices ready. Ellen is on standby.
The kittens open their eyes any day now. Checking on them every hour like a nervous grandma.
Dad is finally coming to visit me abroad. Planning everything I want to show him.
Feeling a spark about the business idea again. Stayed up sketching until 2am.
Our first holiday as a family of four. Suitcases on the bed. Kids already wearing swimsuits indoors.
Got into the pottery residency in Kyoto!!! Leaving in May.
New season of our show drops at midnight. Kemal and I have strict rules: no spoilers, no phones.
The test print of my zine came out beautifully. Launch party next month!
Almost done with the renovation. Floors go in tomorrow. Can practically taste the housewarming.
Bubbling with ideas after the workshop. Filled ten pages of my notebook on the train home.
I'm going to be an aunt!!! Kezia told us at dinner and I screamed in a restaurant.
Finally get my cast off on Thursday. Planning my first swim already.
The garden show is this weekend and my dahlias are blooming at exactly the right time.
Packed for the Arctic trip three days early. Checked the aurora forecast twenty times.
Lunch with Ines on Friday to plan the business properly. Feels real now.
Can't stop smiling about the gig next month. Our biggest venue yet.
Started learning Spanish with an app and I want to practise all the time. Ordering coffee in Spanish next month in Seville!
